name: Mario Pinto
event: UFC Fight Night: Adesanya vs. Magomedov
summary: An unbeaten Portuguese heavyweight (13-0, age 28), tall and long (196 cm, 201 cm reach), from Urban Warriors. He is 4-0 in the UFC since the 2024 Contender Series: TKOs of Austen Lane, Jhonata Diniz and Ryan Spann (R2 in September), and a decision over Felipe Franco.

how_they_fight.Striking: A long, heavy puncher; eight knockouts in our data (four in R1, three in R2, one in R3).
how_they_fight.Grappling: Little evidence either way in our data.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Has gone five rounds once on the regional scene (Aras) and three rounds once in the UFC.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Patient; picks his shots behind his length.

patterns: Length and power; finishes mostly in R1-R2
concerns: Untested against a heavyweight grappler of Spivac's level
keys_to_beat: Take him down early and keep him there

sources.author: Mike Heck
